lead.headline: Ahead after Thursday; Wilson ruled out on the bench
lead.deck: Wilson OUT Friday, Pickens limited all week — both on the bench; every Sunday starter undesignated.
lead.body: The bad news first, and it stays on the bench: Garrett Wilson was ruled out on Friday with the concussion, and George Pickens finished a week of limited practices on his hamstring with ESPN still listing him questionable. Neither starts here. Every Sunday starter is clear: Rashee Rice practised fully, Jonathan Taylor fully after a rest day, and Green Bay listed MarShawn Lloyd questionable, which only firms up Josh Jacobs' workload. Bloodsports lead Jackrabbits 18.9 to 10.88 and ESPN gives a 61% chance. The lineup is the projection lineup; nothing to do. The Colts are still shopping Taylor before Tuesday's NFL deadline; he plays for Indianapolis Sunday.
